full_prompt_en: A square street-art image shows a squat cartoon gentleman centered against a dense neon graffiti wall. He wears an oversized black top hat with a pale band, a glossy black suit, white shirt, and small dark bow tie. His round pale face has simple black eyes, rosy cheeks, a curled white mustache, and a neat smile. One hand rests at his hip while the other rises at the right of the image, holding several yellow banknotes marked with miniature printed shapes too small to read. His short black shoes stand on a scattering of more yellow paper bills across the lower edge. The character is drawn with thick dark contours, broad white facial areas, and shiny highlights on the hat and jacket. Behind him, the wall shifts abruptly between vivid hot pink at the top, turquoise and bright green around the body, and more pink and blue at the sides. Black scrawls, paint drips, splatters, and scraped patches cross these saturated fields. A strip of dull brown-gray wall remains near the bottom, partly covered by the fallen bills. The figure is almost fully visible, with its hat close to the top edge and shoes near the bottom. Light is even and graphic, but white highlights give the black clothing a glossy rounded form. There is no convincing deep space: the character sits directly on a rough painted surface. The composition is loud and frontal, setting a clean comic silhouette against chaotic sprayed color and a low horizontal scatter of money.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形街头艺术图像在密集霓虹涂鸦墙前居中放置一个矮胖的卡通绅士。他戴夸大的黑色高礼帽，帽上有浅色带，身穿发亮黑西装、白衬衫和小深色领结。圆而浅色的脸上有简单黑眼、红润面颊、卷曲白胡子和整齐微笑。一只手叉在腰旁，另一只手在画面右侧抬起，举着几张黄色纸币，纸面印有小到不可读的形状。短黑鞋踩在下边缘散落的更多黄纸币上。人物由粗深轮廓、宽白面部区域，以及帽与外套的亮面高光画成。身后墙面在顶部热粉、身体周围青绿与亮绿、两侧更多粉蓝之间突然跳转。黑色乱线、滴漆、飞溅和刮擦斑块横过这些饱和色场。底部附近还剩一道暗棕灰墙面，部分被落下的纸币盖住。人物几乎全身可见，帽靠近顶边，鞋靠近底边。光线均匀且图形化，但白色亮痕让黑衣具有发亮的圆润体积。空间没有可信的深纵深：人物直接落在粗糙彩绘表面上。构图喧闹而正面，以干净漫画剪影对照混乱喷涂色和低处水平散开的钞票。
style_prompt_en: Street-art image-making sets a clean heavy-outlined cartoon silhouette against rough layers of sprayed and dripped pigment. Use hot pink, turquoise, electric green, cobalt, yellow, black, and white in abrupt saturated blocks. Let splatter, scratches, uneven wall grain, and paint runs stay visible beneath the focal figure, while the figure itself has simpler contours and a few glossy white highlights. Frontal placement and compact proportions make the central form immediately legible; scattered small motifs along the base add restless texture. Lighting is primarily graphic, with highlights used to round selected dark surfaces rather than describe a realistic room. The transferable effect is cheeky and energetic, created by the friction of polished comic drawing with disorderly urban color.
style_prompt_zh: 街头艺术影像把粗重勾线的干净卡通剪影放在粗糙的喷涂与流淌颜料层前。热粉、青绿、电绿、钴蓝、黄、黑与白作为突然跳换的饱和色块。让飞溅、刮痕、不平墙纹和滴漆留在焦点形体下方可见，而焦点本身轮廓更简单，带少数发亮白色高光。正面摆放与紧凑比例使中央形体立即可读；底部散落的小纹样添加躁动纹理。照明主要是图形化的，高光用于使选中的深色表面变圆，而非描绘写实房间。可迁移的效果俏皮且有能量，来自精整漫画绘制与失序都市颜色之间的摩擦。
theme_en: A top-hatted cartoon gentleman holds yellow banknotes before neon graffiti
theme_zh: 高礼帽卡通绅士在霓虹涂鸦前举着黄色纸币
name: Alec Monopoly
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
